text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 429/503 from Okta introspect endpoints observed in eu-central since 09:12 UTC. Symptoms: failed API token introspects, console login loops, elevated 5xxs on auth-proxy. Severity P1. Paging oncall-sre. thread_ts=1830224689

emma.eng: I see a spike in `auth.introspect.errors` and downstream 502s in our api-gateway. Looks correlated to bursts of 429s from `okta.com/oauth2/v1/introspect`.

carlos.support: Tickets coming in: multiple orgs reporting console "spinning on login" and API clients hitting 401s. Prioritizing enterprise customers.

oncall-sre: I'm oncall. Gathering scope: are both hosted and private customers impacted?

emma.eng: Hosted EU tenants majority; a few Dedicated EU tenants also show increased failures where we proxy Okta introspect. Private (on-prem) unaffected.

ops-runbook-bot: runbook:third-party-auth#introspect-failures -> recommended quick mitigations: 1) enable local introspect-cache 2) add client-side retries with exponential backoff 3) reduce non-critical introspect calls for healthchecks.

oncall-sre: I'm going to enable introspect-cache mode on api-gateway for eu-central. That will serve cached introspect responses for up to 30s for valid tokens. Doing change now.

devops: Deploying config patch: `PATCH /v1/configs/api-gateway` payload `{ "region": "eu-central-1", "introspect_cache_ttl": 30 }` rolling restart on 4 pods.

okta-support-bot: Okta status: Partial outage affecting token endpoints in EU region, rate-limiting introduced due to upstream throttling. Case created: #OKTA-78901. Estimated update in 20-40 mins.

(90s later)

oncall-sre: change applied. Introspect failures dropped ~65% in EU slice. API 5xxs returning to baseline. Console login loops still seen for some users due to client retries exhausting.

maya.pm: Can CS prepare a short note: "We're experiencing degraded sign-in and token verification in EU due to an identity provider issue. We've applied temporary caching and retry mitigations to restore service. We're tracking recovery and will update when the provider resolves their incident."

carlos.support: Sending message to affected customers now. Notifying top 10 impacted orgs and offering status calls.

emma.eng: Adding a short-term change to reduce healthcheck introspects: disable token introspect on /health endpoints for 10m. Also enabling 3xx level logs for token flows.

security: Heads-up: caching introspect responses increases acceptance window for revoked tokens. Limit is 30s TTL ok, but ensure we log revocations and have alert for suspicious token usage.

oncall-sre: ack. Enabling additional alerts: `alert_if(token.revocations_seen and region==eu-central)` and `alert_if(introspect.cache_hit_rate>0.7 and failures_persist)`

ops-runbook-bot: incident page created: https://wiki.internal/incidents/1830224689-introspect-rate-limited-okta-eu

(20m later)

okta-support-bot: Okta update: issue under investigation; rate limiting policies adjusted on their side. Service improvement observed but still intermittent for some endpoints.

emma.eng: Observed a second small spike at 09:35 UTC. Applying client-side retry with jitter for introspect path for a short window. Will gate behind feature-flag `eu-introspect-backoff-v1`.

devops: Feature flag rolled out to EU traffic only. Good to monitor for increased latency.

carlos.support: Most customers report restored service. Two enterprise customers still have intermittent 401s; arranging conference with their engineers and Okta support.

incident-bot: Severity downgraded to P2 at 09:49 UTC (1830224940) after mitigations reduced widespread impact. Continue monitoring until stable for 1h.

maya.pm: Planning post-incident review. Action items: 1) Add safe introspect-cache mode to runbook 2) Explore alternative auth provider fallback for critical routes 3) Update client SDKs to exponential backoff by default 4) Customer-facing incident summary.

security: Add a follow-up to review token revocation detection and tighten telemetry around cached acceptance windows.

emma.eng: I've captured traces and sample hashed-token IDs (no PII) into secure bucket s3://redwood-incidents/1830224689/traces.log. Also saved api-gateway logs.

oncall-sre: Handoff plan: @emma.eng will monitor for next 2h, oncall-sre stepping back in 30m. If Okta posts full resolution, revert introspect cache and healthcheck changes and run smoke tests.

emma.eng: acknowledged and will update thread with rollback status.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigations in place, monitoring. last_message_ts=1830225230
